source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Withdrawal report: 'Newtownards - One withdrawal, C. J. Stewart, giving Isaac Baxter an unopposed return for Scrabo Ward.'

note: Annual election of the Newtownards Urban Council, January 1929. All five wards were uncontested: the retiring members were returned unopposed, and in Scrabo Ward C. J. Stewart withdrew, giving Isaac Baxter an unopposed return. At nomination the retiring member D. Jamison did not seek re-election; C. J. Stewart and Isaac Baxter were nominated for the seat, and Stewart afterwards withdrew. Returned unopposed.
